newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - March 10.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - March 10.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Anticipation for further falls in bunker prices kept shipowners away from the market, traders said on Monday. Noting Singapore prices are higher than other ports in the region, most traders expected a downtrend in the near term. "Most shipowners are waiting for further price falls and some majors may lower prices to sell their stocks," said one trader.
